ruleDefinitions.name: User Added To Root/Sudoers Group Using Usermod
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "usermod" binary to add users add users to the root or suoders groups

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/usermod$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-aG\\ root.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-aG\\ sudoers.*")))
